description.zh: 潜行者在 Beta 中的练级加点路线与逐点顺序。
description.en: Level-by-level Rogue talent orders in the Forever beta.

body.zh: 【刺杀 Beta 开荒】先堆暴击，再堆连击点：恶意、击杀后几乎必暴的第一击，以及把连击点还回来的无情。 【战斗 Beta 开荒】更省能量的邪恶攻击、更重的刺骨，再加 3% 命中，招招不落空。完全不点防御天赋。
body.en: [Assassination Beta Start] Critical strike first, then combo points: Malice, a near-guaranteed crit after every kill, and Ruthlessness feeding the next finisher. [Combat Beta Start] A cheaper Sinister Strike, a harder Eviscerate, and 3% hit so nothing whiffs. No defensive talents at all.

body.zh: 以上方案来自 Beta 版本 1.60.1.70425 的公开数据整理，正式版本上线后可能需要重新验证。
body.en: These builds come from published data for beta build 1.60.1.70425 and may need re-verification at launch.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
